items.exampleEn: Salmon swim back to the river where they were born.
items.exampleZh: 鮭魚會游回牠們出生的那條河。

items.exampleEn: It is against the law to drive when you are drunk.
She blends tomatoes and onions to make a sauce.
items.exampleZh: 她把番茄和洋蔥打在一起做醬汁。

items.exampleEn: We ordered fried rice with shrimp.
This dish is made with pork and green beans.
items.exampleZh: 這道菜是用豬肉和四季豆做的。

items.exampleEn: Hunger is still a big problem in many parts of the world.
items.exampleZh: 飢餓在世界上許多地方仍然是個大問題。

items.exampleEn: Peanuts are a cheap and healthy snack.
items.exampleZh: 花生是便宜又健康的點心。

items.exampleEn: Can I have a straw for my milk tea, please?
items.exampleZh: 可以給我一根喝奶茶用的吸管嗎？

items.sentenceEn: I'd like a salmon sandwich and a cup of tea.
items.sentenceZh: 我要一個鮭魚三明治和一杯茶。

items.audioEn: Our cafe no longer gives out plastic straws, but you can ask for a paper one.
items.audioZh: 本咖啡店不再提供塑膠吸管，但你可以索取紙吸管。
items.questionZh: 需要吸管的話該怎麼做？

items.sentenceEn: Do you want shrimp or pork in your soup?
items.sentenceZh: 你的湯要加蝦還是豬肉？

items.sentenceEn: Hunger made it hard for me to study before lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 午餐前肚子餓得讓我很難專心念書。

items.stemEn: He had too much beer at the party and got ____.
items.stemZh: 他在派對上喝了太多啤酒，喝醉了。

items.stemEn: This machine can ____ fruit and ice into a cold drink in seconds.
items.stemZh: 這台機器幾秒鐘就能把水果和冰塊打成冷飲。

items.passageEn: Every Sunday, Ken's family has dinner at a seafood restaurant by the harbor. Ken always orders grilled salmon, and his little sister loves the shrimp. Their father prefers pork, so he usually orders the pork soup. While they wait for the food, the waiter brings the children a small bowl of peanuts. The restaurant gives out paper straws instead of plastic ones. This dinner has become part of the family's weekly routine.
items.passageZh: 每個星期天，Ken 一家人都會到港邊的一家海鮮餐廳吃晚餐。Ken 總是點烤鮭魚，他妹妹最愛吃蝦。他們的爸爸比較喜歡豬肉，所以他通常點豬肉湯。等餐的時候，服務生會給孩子們送來一小碗花生。這家餐廳提供紙吸管，而不是塑膠吸管。這頓晚餐已經成為這家人每週固定的行程。

questions.questionZh: Ken 的爸爸通常點什麼？
等餐的時候，服務生會送來什麼？

referenceEn: My little brother really likes eating peanuts.
